name: questportal-plugins
description: Quest Portal plugins for tabletop roleplaying: the authenticated Quest Portal MCP connection, guest character sheets for Call of Cthulhu, Pendragon and D&D, and the Battlemap pilot.

plugins.name: call-of-cthulhu-plugin
plugins.description: Create and revise populated guest Call of Cthulhu 7e investigators, in batches up to 20, and roll dice with optional private sessions.

plugins.name: pendragon-plugin
plugins.description: Create and revise populated guest Pendragon 6e knights, in batches up to 20, and roll opposed checks and damage.

plugins.name: quest-portal-battlemap
plugins.description: Create and run persistent tactical encounters with shared human and ChatGPT control, deterministic movement, fog, and bounded opponent turns.

plugins.name: dnd-plugin
plugins.description: Create and revise populated guest D&D 2024 characters, in batches up to 20, and roll checks and damage.

plugins.name: questportal-plugin
plugins.description: Connect your Quest Portal account to manage campaigns, notes, characters, scenes and music, and read session history and accessible library sources.
